description_en: Updates the asset name, enabled status, metadata patch, or asset-level chunking configuration. At least one of these items must be provided in the request. Metadata is incrementally merged, and chunkConfiguration triggers asynchronous rechunking. Changes that affect retrieval projections cause the backend to create a new generation and conditionally publish it. Before publication, previously published results remain readable as long as the asset is not disabled, deleted, or unauthorized, and published results are not modified in place. Processing failures in the current phase are not retried. For assets in the FAILED state, only the name or enabled status can be modified. Submitting metadata or chunkConfiguration returns InvalidAssetState
description_zh: 更新资产名称、启用状态、元数据补丁或资产级分块配置，请求至少提供其中一项。metadata 增量合并，chunkConfiguration 触发异步重新分块；影响检索投影的变更由后端创建新代次并条件发布。发布前，旧已发布结果在资产未禁用、未删除且授权仍有效时保持可读，不原地修改已发布结果。本期处理失败后不重试，FAILED 资产仅允许修改 name 或 enabled，提交 metadata 或 chunkConfiguration 返回 InvalidAssetState
name: UpdateAsset

parameters.help_en: Magic resolves the tenant ID from the trusted gateway call identity and verifies workspace ownership. Knowledge bases are created or accessed within this tenant and workspace. Cross-tenant queries cannot be performed by using only the knowledgeBaseId
parameters.help_zh: 由 Magic 从可信网关调用身份解析 tenantId 并校验工作空间归属；知识库在该租户及工作空间内创建或访问，不能仅凭 knowledgeBaseId 跨租户查询
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The knowledge base to which the asset belongs
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

parameters.help_en: The stable identifier of the asset to be updated
parameters.help_zh: 待更新资产的稳定标识
parameters.name: asset_id

fields.help_en: Required when the strategy is BY_HEADING, and the value ranges from 1 to 6. Headings at or above this level are used as boundaries. Deeper headings are retained in the text. Overlong sections fall back to paragraph or sentence chunking, and documents without headings fall back to intelligent chunking. It is ignored for other strategies and validated by the backend according to the strategy
fields.help_zh: BY_HEADING 下必填且范围为 1 至 6。小于等于此级数的标题均作为边界；更深标题保留在正文，超长节按段落或句子回退，无标题文档退化为智能切分。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验
fields.name: heading_level

fields.help_en: Ranges from 1 to 6,000 characters. It uses the character length metric of EB and is not the number of tokens. If omitted, the server default value is used
fields.help_zh: 1 至 6000 字符，沿用 EB 的字符长度口径，不是 Token 数；省略使用服务端默认值
fields.name: max_chunk_size

fields.help_en: Takes effect only when the strategy is BY_LENGTH. The unit is characters, and the default value is 0. The valid value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the valid maxChunkSize, and the length after overlapping must not exceed the maximum chunk size. It is ignored for other strategies and validated by the backend according to the strategy
fields.help_zh: 仅 BY_LENGTH 生效，单位为字符，缺省为 0；有效值须大于等于 0 且小于有效 maxChunkSize，重叠后仍不超过最大分块长度。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验
fields.name: overlap_size

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to remove URLs and email addresses during parsing
fields.help_zh: 是否在解析时删除 URL 和邮箱地址
fields.name: remove_urls_and_emails

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to replace consecutive spaces, line breaks, and tabs with a single space
fields.help_zh: 是否将连续空格、换行、制表符替换为单个空格
fields.name: replace_consecutive_whitespace

fields.help_en: The text preprocessing rules applied before chunking
fields.help_zh: 切分前的文本预处理规则
fields.name: preprocess_rules

fields.help_en: Required and non-empty when the strategy is BY_SEPARATOR. It matches the literal string as a whole and does not use regular expressions. It is ignored for other strategies
fields.help_zh: BY_SEPARATOR 下必填且非空，按字面字符串整体匹配，不使用正则；其他策略忽略
fields.name: separator

fields.help_en: The saved chunking strategy. AUTO indicates automatic chunking, and BY_SEPARATOR indicates chunking by separator. BY_LENGTH and BY_HEADING are returned only for compatibility with historical configurations. When creating or updating a configuration in Phase 1, only AUTO and BY_SEPARATOR are accepted
fields.help_zh: 返回已保存的分块策略。AUTO 为自动分块，BY_SEPARATOR 为分隔符分块；BY_LENGTH 和 BY_HEADING 仅为历史配置兼容返回，新建或更新配置时一期仅接受 AUTO 和 BY_SEPARATOR
fields.name: strategy

fields.help_en: In Phase 1, only AUTO and BY_SEPARATOR are supported, and maxChunkSize ranges from 1 to 6,000 characters. In the UPLOADING state, only the configuration snapshot is updated and used after the upload is confirmed. In the COMPLETED state, the asset is asynchronously reparsed, chunked, and vectorized according to the new policy. Rebuilding chunks overwrites manual text and start/stop modifications. The FAILED state does not support retries. The PENDING, PROCESSING, DELETING, and DELETED states also return InvalidAssetState. Before asynchronous processing succeeds and conditional publication occurs, old results must still pass validation against current permissions, enabled status, and deletion status. If enabled=false is included in the same request, regular reading is stopped immediately
fields.help_zh: 一期仅支持 AUTO 和 BY_SEPARATOR，maxChunkSize 为 1 至 6000 字符。UPLOADING 状态仅更新配置快照，确认上传后使用；COMPLETED 状态按新策略异步重新解析、切分和向量化，重建切片会覆盖人工正文及启停修改。FAILED 状态不支持重试，PENDING、PROCESSING、DELETING、DELETED 状态也返回 InvalidAssetState。异步处理成功并条件发布前，旧结果仍须通过当前权限、启用和删除状态校验；同请求 enabled=false 时立即停止普通读取
fields.name: chunk_configuration

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the asset is enabled. When set to false, the asset is excluded from regular viewing, retrieval, and downloading
fields.help_zh: false 时资产不参与普通查看、检索和下载
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The name of the field declared in the metadataSchema. It must be unique within the same request. Fixed-value and system variable fields are generated by the server and cannot be overwritten by users
fields.help_zh: metadataSchema 中声明的字段名；同一请求中不得重复。固定值及系统变量字段由服务端生成，不接受客户覆盖
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The string parsed according to the schema type. Omitting the value or providing an empty value during upload indicates that no value is assigned, and the value is populated by the schema. In UpdateAsset, omitting the value, setting it to null, or setting it to an empty string indicates that the key is deleted, and unsubmitted keys remain unchanged. For DATETIME, ISO 8601 format with time zone, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, or yyyy-MM-dd is accepted
fields.help_zh: 按 schema 类型解析的字符串。上传时省略或空值表示未赋值，由 schema 填充；UpdateAsset 中省略、null 或空串表示删除该 key，未提交的 key 保持不变。DATETIME 接受 ISO 8601 含时区、yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 或 yyyy-MM-dd
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: Only fields declared in the metadataSchema are allowed. Fields are incrementally merged by key, and unprovided keys are retained. Omitting the value, setting it to null, or setting it to an empty string indicates that the key is deleted. An empty array does not modify any keys. Fixed-value or system variable fields cannot be overwritten or deleted by users, and the backend rejects such modifications. Changes that affect retrieval projections are published with the new generation. Before publication, old results are still validated against current permissions, enabled status, and deletion status. When submitted together with chunkConfiguration, new chunks use the merged metadata
fields.help_zh: 仅允许 metadataSchema 声明的字段，按 key 增量合并，未提供的键保留；value 省略、为 null 或空字符串表示删除该键，空数组不修改任何键。固定值或系统变量字段不可由客户覆盖或删除，后端拒绝此类修改。影响检索投影的变更随新代次发布，发布前旧结果仍受当前权限、启用状态和删除状态校验；与 chunkConfiguration 同传时新分块使用合并后的元数据
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: The updated display name. It can be up to 255 characters in length and does not change the content of the original file
fields.help_zh: 更新后的显示名称，最长 255 个字符，不改变原件内容
fields.name: name

parameters.help_en: At least one of the following parameters must be provided: name, enabled, metadata, or chunkConfiguration
parameters.help_zh: 至少提供 name、enabled、metadata 或 chunkConfiguration 中的一项
parameters.name: body

data.description_en: The management attributes, chunking configuration snapshot, and processing status. Metadata is returned based on the effective view. Patches that affect retrieval return the previous effective values until asynchronous publishing is complete. Acceptance of the request does not indicate that the new result is published. Poll the status by using GetAsset until the status is COMPLETED or FAILED. For the cause of a failure, see lastError
data.description_zh: 返回管理属性、分块配置快照和处理状态；metadata 按已生效视图回显，影响检索的补丁在异步发布完成前仍返回旧生效值。受理不表示新结果已发布，轮询 GetAsset 的 status 至 COMPLETED 或 FAILED，失败原因见 lastError

assetId.description_en: The stable ID of the asset. You can specify this ID when you create an asset. If assetId is not specified but clientToken is provided, the platform stably derives the ID based on the resource scope and clientToken. If neither is provided, a new asset is created for each request. If overwrite=true, a new upload session can be registered for the same asset, and the previously published version continues to be used until the new result is published
assetId.description_zh: 资产的稳定 ID。新建时可指定；未指定 assetId 但提供 clientToken 时由平台按资源范围和 clientToken 稳定派生，两者均未提供时每次请求创建新资产。overwrite=true 可以为同一资产登记新的上传会话，新结果发布前继续使用旧发布版本

chunkConfiguration.description_en: The effective chunking configuration used for the current asset processing. Explicitly uploaded configurations take precedence over the default values of the knowledge base. Subsequent modifications to the knowledge base configuration do not change this snapshot
chunkConfiguration.description_zh: 本次资产处理使用的有效分块配置。上传显式配置优先于知识库默认值；后续知识库配置修改不改变该快照

headingLevel.description_en: Required when the strategy is BY_HEADING, and the value ranges from 1 to 6. Headings at or above this level are used as boundaries. Deeper headings are retained in the text. Overlong sections fall back to paragraph or sentence chunking, and documents without headings fall back to intelligent chunking. It is ignored for other strategies and validated by the backend according to the strategy
headingLevel.description_zh: BY_HEADING 下必填且范围为 1 至 6。小于等于此级数的标题均作为边界；更深标题保留在正文，超长节按段落或句子回退，无标题文档退化为智能切分。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

maxChunkSize.description_en: Ranges from 1 to 6,000 characters. It uses the character length metric of EB and is not the number of tokens. If omitted, the server default value is used
maxChunkSize.description_zh: 1 至 6000 字符，沿用 EB 的字符长度口径，不是 Token 数；省略使用服务端默认值

overlapSize.description_en: Takes effect only when the strategy is BY_LENGTH. The unit is characters, and the default value is 0. The valid value must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than the valid maxChunkSize, and the length after overlapping must not exceed the maximum chunk size. It is ignored for other strategies and validated by the backend according to the strategy
overlapSize.description_zh: 仅 BY_LENGTH 生效，单位为字符，缺省为 0；有效值须大于等于 0 且小于有效 maxChunkSize，重叠后仍不超过最大分块长度。其他策略忽略，由后端按策略校验

preprocessRules.description_en: The text preprocessing rules applied before chunking
preprocessRules.description_zh: 切分前的文本预处理规则

removeUrlsAndEmails.description_en: Specifies whether to remove URLs and email addresses during parsing
removeUrlsAndEmails.description_zh: 是否在解析时删除 URL 和邮箱地址

replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_en: Specifies whether to replace consecutive spaces, line breaks, and tabs with a single space
replaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_zh: 是否将连续空格、换行、制表符替换为单个空格

separator.description_en: Required and non-empty when the strategy is BY_SEPARATOR. It matches the literal string as a whole and does not use regular expressions. It is ignored for other strategies
separator.description_zh: BY_SEPARATOR 下必填且非空，按字面字符串整体匹配，不使用正则；其他策略忽略

strategy.description_en: The saved chunking strategy. AUTO indicates automatic chunking, and BY_SEPARATOR indicates chunking by separator. BY_LENGTH and BY_HEADING are returned only for compatibility with historical configurations. When creating or updating a configuration in Phase 1, only AUTO and BY_SEPARATOR are accepted
strategy.description_zh: 返回已保存的分块策略。AUTO 为自动分块，BY_SEPARATOR 为分隔符分块；BY_LENGTH 和 BY_HEADING 仅为历史配置兼容返回，新建或更新配置时一期仅接受 AUTO 和 BY_SEPARATOR

chunkCount.description_en: The total number of chunks in the currently published result. This value is 0 before the first publishing. During re-chunking or editing, the published result is still counted
chunkCount.description_zh: 当前已发布结果的 Chunk 总数，首次发布前为 0；重新分块或编辑处理中仍统计已发布结果

contentType.description_en: The MIME type of the uploaded original file for the asset
contentType.description_zh: 该资产上传原件的 MIME 类型

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 UTC format

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether the asset is enabled. If the asset is disabled, it is excluded from regular viewing, retrieval, and downloading. Management APIs remain subject to management permissions
enabled.description_zh: 禁用后不参与普通查看、检索和下载；管理接口仍受管理权限控制

fileName.description_en: The file name of the currently uploaded original file. Modifying the display name does not change this value
fileName.description_zh: 当前上传原件的文件名；修改显示名称不改变此值

knowledgeBaseId.description_en: The knowledge base to which the asset belongs

lastError.description_en: The data masking error for the current upload or processing. This error does not contain internal credentials, paths, or run identifiers
lastError.description_zh: 当前上传或处理的脱敏错误；不含内部凭据、路径和运行标识

code.description_en: The stable product error code. This code does not return internal task identifiers, stack traces, or storage addresses
code.description_zh: 稳定的产品错误码；不返回内部任务标识、堆栈或存储地址

message.description_en: The data masking error summary that can be displayed to users
message.description_zh: 可向用户展示的脱敏错误摘要

metadata.description_en: The complete list of effective metadata key-value pairs, including constants and system variable results. Patches that involve retrieval projection do not overwrite the previous effective values until the new result is published
metadata.description_zh: 已生效的完整元数据键值列表，含常量和系统变量结果；涉及检索投影的补丁在新结果发布前不覆盖旧生效值

key.description_en: The name of the field declared in the metadataSchema. It must be unique within the same request. Fixed-value and system variable fields are generated by the server and cannot be overwritten by users
key.description_zh: metadataSchema 中声明的字段名；同一请求中不得重复。固定值及系统变量字段由服务端生成，不接受客户覆盖

value.description_en: The string parsed according to the schema type. Omitting the value or providing an empty value during upload indicates that no value is assigned, and the value is populated by the schema. In UpdateAsset, omitting the value, setting it to null, or setting it to an empty string indicates that the key is deleted, and unsubmitted keys remain unchanged. For DATETIME, ISO 8601 format with time zone, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, or yyyy-MM-dd is accepted
value.description_zh: 按 schema 类型解析的字符串。上传时省略或空值表示未赋值，由 schema 填充；UpdateAsset 中省略、null 或空串表示删除该 key，未提交的 key 保持不变。DATETIME 接受 ISO 8601 含时区、yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss 或 yyyy-MM-dd

name.description_en: The display name of the asset. By default, the uploaded file name is used. You can modify the display name by using UpdateAsset
name.description_zh: 默认采用上传文件名，可通过 UpdateAsset 修改显示名称

publishedResultAvailable.description_en: Indicates whether the published result is available. This value is true if a published version exists and the asset is neither disabled nor deleted. This value may still be true if re-chunking or editing fails, and is false if the first processing fails
publishedResultAvailable.description_zh: 已发布版本存在且资产未禁用、未删除时为 true；重新分块或编辑失败时可能仍为 true，首次处理失败时为 false

sizeBytes.description_en: The size of the current original file in bytes. This value is not returned before the upload is confirmed. After confirmation, the actual size verified by the OSS HEAD request is returned
sizeBytes.description_zh: 当前原件字节数；上传确认前不返回，确认后返回经 OSS HEAD 校验的实际大小

sourceModifiedTime.description_en: The last modification time of the source file in UTC epoch milliseconds. This value is not returned if it is not provided
sourceModifiedTime.description_zh: 源文件最后修改时间，UTC epoch 毫秒；未提供时不返回

sourceType.description_en: The import channel of the asset, such as UPLOAD or OSS. This value is recorded by the platform based on the trusted access path and is not used to grant access permissions
sourceType.description_zh: 资产导入渠道，如 UPLOAD、OSS；由平台根据可信接入路径记录，不用于授予访问权限

sourceUri.description_en: The URI of the original file source. This URI is used only for tracing. It does not grant download permissions or trigger server-side fetching
sourceUri.description_zh: 原件来源的 URI，仅用于溯源，不是下载授权，也不触发服务端抓取

status.description_en: The current upload or processing status of the document. Poll the status by using GetAsset for uploads, rebuilds, and chunk content edits. PENDING indicates that the task is waiting to be processed. PROCESSING indicates that the task is being processed. COMPLETED indicates that publishing is complete. FAILED indicates that the task ultimately failed, and lastError is returned. This status does not represent the result of a specific historical request. No readable result is available if the first processing fails. During overwrite uploads, rebuilds, or edits, and after a failure, the published result remains readable if the enabled and deletion statuses allow it
status.description_zh: 文档当前上传或处理状态。上传、重建和 Chunk 正文编辑均通过 GetAsset 轮询；PENDING 为等待处理，PROCESSING 为正在处理，完成发布后为 COMPLETED，最终失败为 FAILED 并返回 lastError。不表示某次历史请求的结果。首次处理失败没有可读结果；覆盖上传、重建或编辑期间以及失败后，已发布结果在启用和删除状态允许时仍可读

updatedAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 UTC format

workspaceId.description_en: The workspace to which the asset belongs

message.description_en: The description of the data masking result

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
